body: I'll start by reading the required documents and understanding the existing code structure.
Now I'll implement the changes. Starting with the `AttrValue::Map` variant and canonical constructor.
Now the complete schema. Creating a focused module with helpers, nodes, and marks.

Implemented the core schema/attribute slice. Both acceptance commands are green.

## Behavior added

**Attribute system**
- `AttrType::{Enum, List, Map}` (recursive; `Enum` is a closed string set).
- `AttrValue::Map` with `AttrMap`/`AttrMapEntry` aliases and canonical `AttrValue::map()` (lexically sorted, duplicate keys rejected).
- Recursive validation in `Schema::value_matches`/`validate_value`: enum membership, list element type, map key ordering + value type.
- Wire decode/encode: enum, list, map; map keys canonicalized on decode; `Any` objects without `doc` decode as maps; maps encode as sorted JSON objects.
- Limits: nested values now respect `max_depth`; map keys use `max_attr_string_bytes`; values recurse.
- Fingerprint already consumes `AttrType`/`AttrValue` via canonical `Debug`, so new types are included; test proves enum changes alter the fingerprint.

**Complete schema**
- `Schema::full()` in `schema/full/` with: paragraph, heading, bullet/ordered lists, list_item, blockquote, code_block, **raw_code**, table/table_caption/table_row/table_header/table_cell, figure/caption, separator, image/video/audio/attachment (atoms), hard_break, text; marks strong/em/code/underline/strike/highlight/sup/sub/link/ref.
- Doc attrs: `lang`, `dir` (enum), `title`, `description`, `canonical_url`, `authors`/`tags` (list), `metadata` (map).
- Raw code: `text*`, attrs `language`/`format`/`filename`/`meta`/`line_numbers`, role `CodeBlock`.
- `Schema::basic()` preserved unchanged.

**Accessibility**
- `A11yNode::code_language` added and populated from the `language` attr; emitted in a11y JSON.

**ProblemDetails**
- `error::ProblemDetails` with RFC 9457 fields (`type_uri`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `instance`, `code`, `suggestion`), constructors for `unknown_token`/`unknown_attr`/`unknown_mark`/`unrepresentable_feature`/`limit_exceeded`, plus `PROBLEM_BASE` and `suggestion_for_token` conversion advice. Not wired into the parser yet, per instruction.

## Files
Modified: `src/model/attrs.rs`, `src/model/limits.rs`, `src/model/mod.rs`, `src/schema/spec.rs`, `src/schema/mod.rs`, `src/wire/attrs.rs`, `src/wire/writer.rs`, `src/a11y/tree.rs`, `src/a11y/build.rs`, `src/a11y/json.rs`, `src/error/mod.rs`.
New: `src/error/problem.rs`, `src/schema/full/{mod,attrs,nodes,marks}.rs`, `tests/schema_full.rs`.

## Verification
- `cargo test -p rich-editor-auy --locked`: **51 passed, 0 failed** (18 suites; 10 in `schema_full`).
- `cargo clippy -p rich-editor-auy --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo check --workspace --locked`: clean.
- `cargo fmt --check` still reports diffs only in files owned by other concurrent agents (`state/composition.rs`, `tests/history.rs`, `tests/common/mod.rs`); all my files were rustfmt-formatted.

Notes: no WASM/TS/plan changes, no new deps, no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`, all `src/` files ≤300 lines. I did not edit `CHANGELOG.md`/docs to avoid cross-slice conflicts; `Schema::full`, the new `AttrType`/`AttrValue` variants, aliases, `A11yNode::code_language`, and `ProblemDetails` are public API and likely need a changelog entry at integration.
